name: Intuit Inc.
monetization: Sells TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp; pays OpenAI >$100M multi-year for model access and distribution of its apps inside ChatGPT.
description_md: Intuit is a financial-software incumbent using frontier models two ways: embedding OpenAI models in its own 'done-for-you' agentic experiences, and distributing TurboTax/QuickBooks/Credit Karma/Mailchimp as apps inside ChatGPT (announced Nov 18, 2025). One of the clearest examples of an app-layer company paying nine figures for model access — the demand side of AI revenue quality.
